failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 2 query: 'When was "Take Off" music video by 2PM released?' Hop 3 query: '2PM Take Off music video release date'. Both queries target the same information (Take Off release date) with near-identical intent. Hop 2 already retrieved the passage 'Take Off (2PM song) | "Take Off" is the debut Japanese single by South Korean boy band, 2PM. This single was released on May 18, 2011...', yet hop 3 re-asks for the same release date information, resulting in retrieving the identical passage again.
